name: Taco Smell — Restaurant Escape (Stage 1)
design_status: prototype layout, subject to emulator playtesting
coordinate_system: (0,0) top-left, x increases right, y increases down; integers only

G.name: grease_spill
G.effect_v01: none; reserved for slip mechanics in later build

F.name: front_entrance
F.effect_v01: passage/spawn marker; leaving map is forbidden

N.name: kitchen_side_entrance
N.effect_v01: later-stage hazmat entrance; leaving map is forbidden

X.name: rear_escape_exit
X.effect_v01: touching tile with Billy completes Stage 1

prototype_render.mode: 40-column Atari character-mode mockup; actual ANTIC choice deferred
prototype_render.map_tile_glyphs: Debug glyphs only; final visual charset not selected

prototype_rules.player_movement: four cardinal directions; block moves entering a solid tile or leaving map bounds; no diagonal movement
prototype_rules.player_collision: tile-based for first playable; smoother/sub-tile movement is later work
prototype_rules.enemy_v01: one hazmat worker appears at 3s, moves toward Billy on non-solid cardinal tiles; pursuit tick/speed requires playtesting
prototype_rules.caught_v01: show CAUGHT and restart the stage; no life deduction in prototype
prototype_rules.win_v01: Billy enters X at (47,10); show STAGE COMPLETE rather than launching Road 1 yet
prototype_rules.fire_v01: not implemented; indoor directional gas-blast controls to be designed/tested later
prototype_rules.timing: 70–105 second full-stage pacing is a design target, not guaranteed by this first layout
